scope: Read-only snapshots of fixed-vLLM 0.31.0 compiled computation_graph.py from the old guard-v1 and revised Stream-K-v2 API containers
method: Count Python code lines containing direct operator calls; exclude source-location comment lines. Both source files were copied from their containers with docker cp and then copied locally without editing.
conclusion: The revised opaque down-dispatch op is present in the v2 compiled graph, whereas it is absent from guard-v1. This establishes graph insertion only; it does not establish that an M=5 CUDA graph replay executed the Stream-K kernel or that normal API latency changed because of it.
